text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho is right around the corner. 
The crowd is buzzing with anticipation to 
see if the first Triple Tiara Umamusume 
since Mejiro Ramonu will be born—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That wasn't really the case either.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Well, Double Tiara Umamusume pop up every 
now and then... So there's a good chance 
she'll end up stopping there too.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, what about Admire 
Groove?! They're saying she's finally 
awakened, right? I saw it online!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I really want her to do well. Her talent's 
top-notch, right?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That girl... has a prickly edge to her, 
but... For some reason, she really makes 
you expect great things from her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While waiting for the arrival of autumn, 
the expectations placed on Still in Love 
had faded once again.
choice_data_list: (Why does it always end up like this...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hold back the thought, "Even though 
she's a Double Tiara Umamusume..." Because 
the person herself is—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: (I'm more focused now than ever before.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ......It feels pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Deep down, she is enduring it for me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So that I may savor this moment of pure 
joy... in the best possible condition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is something only she can feel... 
Sadly, I cannot reach into her inner 
conflict. Even so—
choice_data_list:
If there's anything I can do, just let me 
know.

If there's anything I can do, just let me 
know.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...In that case.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Could you please... give my cheek a 
little slap?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... U-Um. I didn't mean anything weird 
by that...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I've seen it in TV dramas and such as a 
way to psych oneself up...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I was just... admiring how openly you can 
connect with each other like that... um...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ! Y-Yes...
choice_data_list: (I'll pour my prayers into this for her.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she wins today, she will undoubtedly 
go down in history. When that happens... 
it won't just be support in the near 
future. She will continue to be loved by 
people for generations to come."
choice_data_list:
You're strong. Truly worthy of the Triple 
Tiara.
You're strong. Worthy of the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I will definitely return 
victorious. And then—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I dedicate this glorious tiara to you...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Only the last one is something I won't 
give up.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Then, on the turf—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Absolutely not!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose! ...I'm telling you, I won't 
lose...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"You want to prove yourself too, don't 
you? I can tell... because we're the 
same."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: However, ――my resolve is different.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
My love is... strong. I will achieve the 
Triple Tiara, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...! No, that's not love—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win! Otherwise... what has 
everything up until now been for...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...If you're hesitating at this point, 
then all the more... I don't feel like 
losing."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: My feelings... have been set.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
This Triple Tiaraâ I will not let it be 
taken from me!!
